plugins.name: cyberine-releaseguard
plugins.description: Stops accidental source and secret leaks when you publish or deploy: a zero-dependency gate for npm tarballs, wheels, crates, VS Code, Electron, NuGet, gem, Helm and container artifacts, plus a PreToolUse hook that asks before an unchecked publish, upload or deploy, and skills for the safe build-pack-check-publish procedure.

skills.name: check
skills.description: Use when the user wants to know whether a package, archive or build output would leak source or secrets, without publishing or deploying it. Packs the real tarball (or takes a given file or build directory), runs the shipsafe gate, and explains each finding with its fix.

skills.name: help
skills.description: Use when the request names Cyberine ReleaseGuard, releaseguard or shipsafe but not which `/cyberine-releaseguard:*` command answers it, such as what the plugin can do or which command fits a task. Routes to the one skill that answers it (release, init, check, verify, incident). Does not fire without a shipsafe or releaseguard anchor; a bare publish request goes to /cyberine-releaseguard:release directly.

skills.name: incident
skills.description: Use when a published npm package may have leaked source or a secret, including requests to audit published versions or to unpublish or deprecate a leaked version. Scans published versions with shipsafe audit, separates credential exposure (rotate first) from source exposure, and walks the user through npm's unpublish and deprecate rules without promising removal.
headings: 3. Stop the next install from getting it

skills.name: init
skills.description: Use when a repo that publishes to npm should be set up so its releases cannot ship source by accident. Audits package.json and the build config, proposes the fixes, and runs a first gate on a real tarball.
headings: 4. CI (offer; write it only when asked)

skills.name: release
skills.description: Use when the user is about to publish or release an npm package, or asks how to ship a package without its source. Builds, packs the real tarball, gates it with shipsafe, and hands the human the exact publish command for their OTP; never publishes.

skills.name: verify
skills.description: Use after an npm publish to prove the registry holds exactly the tarball that was checked. Compares the registry's dist.integrity for name@version with the local .tgz and runs a no-scripts install smoke test.
